answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46509 Country: India Title: Regarding Prayer Question: I live in Kanpur. I am confused that what time of salah should I follow either old or new one. Our mufti sahab says to follow new timing; and there is a branch of Nadwa Darul Taleem Wasnat they follow old timing? Which one is better? What did you follow? Answer ID: 46509 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1176/1119/N=9/1434) A calendar which is more accurate in the light of observation of celestial signs should be followed. The calendar which we follow was confirmed by observations. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
